implementation_semantics.collector: New exact-scope authenticated read-only Pepperstone cTrader/Open API collector
implementation_semantics.execution: No orders, no account mutation, no synthetic fills, no forward filling, no resampling during capture
implementation_semantics.external_gate: Implementation must freeze this exact scope and capture plan, obtain exact-head-green binding, then request deterministic account-bound capture acceptance before screening.
implementation_semantics.integrity: M5 alignment, chronological audit, duplicate/conflict detection, exact symbol ID/name matching, deterministic hash-bound package

scope_exclusions: Do not reuse the exact C031 twelve-symbol identity.
Do not reuse the completed six-symbol independent outer as confirmatory evidence.
Do not open economic outcomes, promotion, live orders, or protected forward evidence.

screening_design.economic_boundary: Structural evidence only; no strategy P&L, compounded equity, identity creation, or economic promotion.
selection_basis: Exact account-native symbol identity and feasibility index match
Disjointness from current ten-symbol development capture, C031 twelve-symbol scope, and completed six-symbol outer
structural_outputs: volume lattice and minimum executable-volume descriptors

required_pre_capture_checks: Verify exact broker symbol IDs and names against the accepted feasibility index
Verify all symbols are BOTH_FEASIBLE at initial EUR200 and non-test
Verify disjointness from all consumed exact identities and completed outers
Freeze capture interval, fields, integrity rules, and structural screen before data access

objective.goal: Extend the development-only structural evidence frontier with a small, account-feasible, non-overlapping cross-asset panel without rerunning C031 or reopening any economic identity.
objective.information_gain_rationale: The accepted account-native universe contains 1641 feasible non-test symbols across materially different asset classes, product types, and schedules, while prior evidence covers only narrow exact scopes. A balanced eight-symbol wave can test whether structural opportunity and data quality generalize beyond the observed C031 and six-symbol surfaces before any expensive economic evaluation.
